canonical_project: ZalaZONE EMAK Energy Management Data Center, Zalaegerszeg
owner: ZalaZONE InnoTech Nonprofit Kft. / Szechenyi Istvan University
notes: ZalaZONE's official research page describes EMAK as a prototype Energy Management Data Center tied to the ZalaZONE automotive proving ground in Zalaegerszeg. The supporting peer-reviewed article says the EMAK project established a complex data collection, processing, and analysis system for energy management, with servers at the ZalaZONE site. This appears to be an R&D/industrial energy-management data platform rather than a hyperscale, colocation, or cloud-region data center; no IT load or power capacity was disclosed.
